title: Minds that change
sub: The sixth film of What an agent is, a series on what an AI agent is and what it isn't: an agent invents and changes its answer, and so do we, since our memory rebuilds itself each time we remember; the answer isn't blame but evidence and checks, the same for people and agents.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model, orange the data and its evidence, green what is checked and agrees, amber a slip or a doubt.
